_source: Surveyed off seeds/Shockwave 1035.gdl (every page's controls and per-state looks via gdl.project.Project), cross-checked against seeds/Shockwave 1535.gdl and seeds/Shockwave ECP 16-10.gdl, which share its palette byte for byte. The template's own defaults (`python -m gdl.themes "Shockwave 1020 Series.glt"`: fills #3B2F2A, #999999, #FFFFFF; borders 2D Rounded Rectangle, 2D Rectangle, 2D Capsule) corroborate it.

Shockwave draws its buttons as kit images, not fills: every seed button state names an image and none authors a fill, except the header's source tabs, whose glyphs sit on #3B2F2A and light to white at alpha 60 when On. A button's color is which image family it names - gray, red, yellow, green, blue - and each family rests dark with a ring in its color (`<color>_outline_nsel`) and lights up when selected (`<color>_sel`); kit.outline_off reads the kit so. The seed's pressed captions: black on gray, #75063C on red, #946E06 on yellow, #355424 on green.

Colors: page #3B2F2A is the header and footer bars and a source tab at rest; raised #999999 is every modal's card (Help, Confirmation, Camera Select, Incoming Call...); text-secondary #474747 is the text on it; ink #000000 is a lit button's caption; well is the video well, white at 15% over the photo - the seed authors it opaque white at transparencyField 85 (docs/gdl-format.md section 7), which the spec says as the fill's alpha. The clock takes raised's gray, as the seed's footer draws it. `alert` is the seed's pressed caption on red (Power, Mute), and yellow's and green's are left out: with them the palette is eight colors against Extron's six (docs/design-rules.md section 2), and ink reads on every lit image.

Layout, from Main SD: a #3B2F2A header 1280x91 holding the source tabs (152x91 each from x 169); the video well 926x574 at 168,120 (Shape1, 2D Rounded Rectangle, white at 85% transparency, where the chosen source's popup shows); the left rail at x 29 (Display On/Off/Mute 120x80, Screen/Lighting Control 120x110) and the right at x 1127-1163 (Volume slider 52x315, Mute 80x80, Audio Control 120x110), each under a white 18 pt label; and a #3B2F2A 2D Capsule footer 928x62 at 166,718 holding Room Mode, the date and time and Help, with Power outside it at 1115,720.

Modals: no seed popup carries a scrim, so `scrim` is page at alpha 166, the modal dim the toolkit draws for every template. Help's card is 703x453 at 288,173, its title 40 pt and its Close a dark X (icons/440x440 Black/black_close.png, named in kit.named) that turns white (white_close.png) inside a 3D Rounded Rectangle Selected ring when pressed.

Slider: every seed slider is image-drawn - track 52 wide, thumb 52x34, Slider/156x1026_sw_track_bg.png under 156x1026_sw_fill.png and 156x102_sw_thumb.png - with no fill or thumb color at all. The seed has no level; `level` is assumed.

Type is Open Sans regular throughout (no seed label or button authors bold) at 1.375 px per point (docs/gdl-format.md section 2). The seed's 12 pt button captions are lifted to the 14 pt floor gdl.spec checks. The Start page's Roboto light-preset captions are left out: the system carries one family.

Backgrounds: the seed stretches SW_bkgd_01.png (1366x768) over every work page (backgroundImageLayoutField 1); the kit's own 1280x800 copy of it is `haze`, and its Saturn photo, the Start page's, is `saturn`.
title: Extron Shockwave
tagline: Extron's Shockwave touch-panel template, for TLP Pro panels.

schemes.name: Shockwave
schemes.usage: Shockwave's one palette. Its color choices are per button - which image family a button names - not a scheme.

colors.name: page
colors.usage: The header and footer bars, and a source tab at rest. Behind them, the theme's photo.

colors.name: pressed
colors.usage: A source tab when On: white at alpha 60 over its glyph.

colors.name: raised
colors.usage: A modal's card. Also the clock's color on the footer.

colors.name: text
colors.usage: Captions on a button at rest, labels on the photo or a bar.

colors.name: text-secondary
colors.usage: Text on a modal's card: its title and message.

colors.name: ink
colors.usage: A lit button's caption - the kit's selected images are light.

colors.name: well
colors.usage: The video well, where the chosen source's page shows: white at 15% over the photo.

colors.name: alert
colors.usage: A red button's caption when lit: Power and Mute, as the seed draws them.

colors.name: scrim
colors.usage: Behind a modal's card: page at alpha 166.

colors.name: header
colors.usage: A hub's header strip across the top of main (the 525's and 535's Select a Source, and each popup over it): black at alpha 115. Its menu bar draws near it, and the region page draws it in this.

type.name: title
type.usage: A modal's title (HELP) - the seed's largest label.

type.name: heading
type.usage: A modal's message: the power-down question, an incoming call.

type.name: body-strong
type.usage: A rail's label over its controls (Display, Volume), and a large button's caption.

type.name: body
type.usage: Status text and a call button's caption; the clock.

type.name: button
type.usage: A button's caption - the seed's 12 pt lifted to the 14 pt floor - and a source tab's name.

rect.usage: A square-cornered bar: the header. In seeds/Shockwave 1035.gdl it draws no stroke.

rounded.usage: A modal's card and the video well.

rounded-3d-selected.usage: The ring a modal's Close gains when pressed.

none.usage: No border: the kit's image draws the button's whole shape.

button.usage: The default: a rounded button from the kit, dark with a ring at rest and lit when On - the seed's rail buttons (Display On, Off, Mute), 120x80. `icon` names its color: gray (the default), red, yellow, green or blue.

tile.usage: A squarer button for a two-line caption - the seed's Screen Control and Audio Control, 120x110. `icon` names its color as `button`'s does.

square.usage: A square button - the seed's volume Mute, 80x80. `icon` names its color, or a kit icon drawn in it (mic-mute-1_yellow), which takes no caption.

pill.usage: A pill - the footer's Help (yellow) and Power (red), 143x59. `icon` names its color as `button`'s does.

wide.usage: A wide button with its caption centered - a modal's choices, 272x110. `icon` names its color; add `_round` for a pill (green_round, red_round, gray_round).

action.usage: A wide pill with the kit's icon at its left and the caption after it - Accept Call, Ignore Call, Presentation, 272x110. `icon` is required: r_call_green, r_end-call_red, r_help_yellow, r_power_red, r_mic_yellow, r_share-1_blue, r_presentation_gray; without the r_ prefix the button is rounded rather than round.
action.caption: indent

source.usage: A source tab in the header: the kit's white glyph on the bar, lit white when chosen, with its name below - the seed's PC, Laptop, Blu-ray, 152x91. `icon` is a glyph: laptop_white, pc_white, sharelink_white, hdmi_white, doc-cam_white, blu-ray-2_white, apple-tv_white.
source.caption: below

device.usage: A hub's Select a Source tile: the kit's whole-device outline (icons/440x440 White, white_<device>) over a translucent rounded tile that lights when pressed, its name a label under it - the 525's and 535's seeds' Laptop, PC, Aux, 190x135. `icon` is the device: laptop, pc, doc-cam, sharelink, apple-tv, hdmi.
device.caption: none

close.usage: A modal's Close: the kit's dark X, white inside a ring when pressed. About 40x40, at the card's top right.
close.caption: none

cover.pattern: rounded tiles cut at Shockwave's 10 px radius

iconography.icon_prop: Each image is the whole button, at rest and lit: state 0 draws it at rest, the others lit.
iconography.intro: Shockwave draws every button from its kit: one image per state, which carries the button's shape, color and any icon. At rest a button is dark with a ring in its color; lit, it fills with that color and its caption turns `ink`. Name the image with a Button's `icon` - never draw a button's shape or an icon yourself.
rules: **Color is the image family**: `gray` for most buttons, `yellow` for help, `red` for power and mute, `green` to confirm or answer a call, `blue` to share. Add `_round` on a `wide` button for a pill.

**Which button**: rail buttons are `button` (120x80); a two-line name is a `tile` (120x110); a square control is `square` (80x80); the footer's Help and Power are `pill`s (143x59); a modal's choices are `wide` (272x110), or `action` with the kit's icon at the left (r_call_green, r_end-call_red). Sources are `source` tabs in the header: a white glyph (laptop_white, pc_white) on the bar, lit white when chosen. A modal closes with `close`, the kit's X.
**Feedback**: state 0 draws the image at rest, the others lit. A state can name its own `icon` to change color - a yellow Ready, a green Live.

examples.states_note: In Shockwave a state shows itself through the kit's image: a state can name its own `icon` (color) and `look` (off rests dark with a ring, on lights up), and a lit image takes an `ink` caption.
examples.group_note: Neither is Shockwave's: its source row is six 152x91 tabs across the header, butted. Set `cap`, `cell` and `gap` for the group you mean.
examples.color_rule: A theme's photo behind everything; `page` for the header and footer bars and the source tabs; `well` for the video well, with `text` on it; `ink` for a lit button's caption; `raised` for a modal's card with `text-secondary` on it; a button's color from its kit family - gray for most, yellow for help, red for power and mute, green to confirm or call, blue to share; `alert` only as a lit red button's caption.

themes.name: Haze
themes.usage: A soft blur of warm grays - the seed's own, behind every work page.

themes.name: Saturn
themes.usage: Saturn and its rings on black - the seed's Start page.

layout.bars_note: Its bars and rails are controls over the photograph, not background art, so on a panel other than the one drawn a Page's own children go through both panels' bands (docs/claude-design.md section 4).

hub_header._source: How deep the header comes out on each hub holding the Layout's own source tabs - six 152x91 `source` tabs in a joined Group from x 169, with captions the length of the seed's (PC, Laptop, Blu-ray, ShareLink, HDMI, Doc Cam): a band beside main is as deep as a Group it holds (bundle.js touchIn), and the tabs grow to their captions at the hub's type floor; longer captions are deeper. Measured by the bundle in headless Chrome, and re-measured by tests/test_design.py. The README's room for a hub reads it, where it assumed a button.

layout.main_note: The video well: a `well` Panel with the `rounded` border, where the chosen source shows, or its name and status in white while nothing is connected.
regions: **The header (1280x91 at 0,0) is a `page` Panel with the source tabs across it**: `source` buttons 152x91 in a `Group joined="true"`, flush as the seed draws them - a joined row is one control strip, which the 12 px the toolkit checks between touchable controls does not split, and it stays a row on every panel - their names below their glyphs, the row centered on the page (the seed starts its six at x 169, over the well's left edge; fewer than that reads lopsided there).

**The left rail (x 29, 120 wide) holds the display**: a `Display` label in `body-strong`, then `button`s 120x80, 12 px apart (the seed's are 4 apart, under the 12 px the toolkit checks between two touchable controls), and `tile`s 120x110 below for anything with a two-line name (Screen Control, Lighting Control).

**The right rail (x 1127, 120 wide) holds volume**: a `Volume` label, a slider centered under it (the seed's is 52x315; make it 54 wide, since 52 is under the 53 px touch minimum the toolkit checks), a `square` Mute 80x80 below (icon red), and an Audio Control `tile`.

**The footer is a `page` Panel with the `capsule` border, 928x62 at 166,718**: a `wide` Room Mode (gray_round) at its left, the date and time centered in `raised`, and a `pill` Help (yellow) at its right. Power, a red `pill` 143x59, sits outside it at 1115,720.

regions._source: What the region components draw by default (docs/claude-design.md section 3): the clock's pattern off the seed's own Main SD (the 1035's Date/Time draws 9/28/1960 12:00 AM), and each control in the look this profile measured for it off the 1035's seed (layout.regions and the variants' usage): the source tabs `source`; the rail's Display buttons `button`, its launchers `tile`; a `wide` gray_round Room Mode; a red `square` Mute; a yellow `pill` Help; Power a red `pill` captioned Off, as the seed's Power Down Text. Not yet verified by a GUI Designer build of a region page. `rail` is a LeftRail's first group's, `launcher` its later groups' and Audio Control's, `mode` the Footer's mode slot's.

mute.does: Mutes the program audio; On while muted.

regions._center: What a source popup (role="source") and a window draw (docs/claude-design.md section 4), off the 1035's and 725's seeds' Laptop, Doc Cam, Help, Confirmation, Powering Down and Lighting Control: the source's title Open Sans 40 white, centred across the popup's top; 'Please connect your laptop.' 22 pt white in the upper half of the empty state's box over a 16 pt Disconnected status centred at its foot, 30% of it each way; the popup's headings 18 pt white and its keys the 504x440 gray `tile`; a window's title 40 pt #474747 (`text-secondary`) centred, its message 26 pt #474747, Close the kit's dark X (`close`), Power Down a green_round `wide` pill and Cancel a red_round one, captioned 18 pt. Those sizes are the 1035's: a source popup and a window set what they say at each panel's own template's size, its frame's `pt` (Help's message 20 pt, the 725's titles 30).
regions._hub: What a hub's region page, source popups and windows draw (the 525's and 535's Main Page, Laptop, Display Control, More Options, Volume Level and Help). Measured off the 525 seed: titles Open Sans 30 white (the frame's pt) on a black 45% strip (`header`, #00000073) across the popup's top; a tile's name 14 pt white under it; the menu bar's Up, Down, Mute, Display Control and More on one art, the kit's 712x440 gray (`button`: the seed's image 15, 92x54, lit 712x440 gray sel), Mute lit red (the seed's image 17, 712x440 red sel); Power the kit's 440x440 power_red, a square power glyph in a crimson ring (image 18); every hub Close the white X at rest and the dark one pressed (images 44 and 45: white_close, black_close), where the card's Close is the other way about; Help the kit's help_yellow (image 34); the options' glyphs the kit's lightbulb_white and speaker_white. Chosen by eye: Up and Down Open Sans's Λ and V for the template's Extron-Shockwave chevrons, which its kit has no art for; a tile the source tab's glyph art on the `well` wash in a rounded `pressed` ring, for the template's own translucent rounded tile. Known differences: its tile's glyph is the tab art's, about a third the size of the template's line art; the menu's words, set at 12 pt under the 525's 18 pt floor, grow their cells; the Volume Level strip's glyphs are Extron GUI Configurator characters and are not drawn.

writing._source: The template's own words, off the 1035's and 725's seeds (their Laptop and PC popups, Confirmation, Starting Up, Powering Down and Help) and the grammar digest of every Shockwave page: a bar series' source with no controls asks for it to be connected ({noun} the popup's title in sentence case: 'laptop', 'PC') over a status the program sets, Disconnected; the hubs and the 320 say '<X> is currently selected.' instead (`hub_empty`, which a source popup on a hub says). The question and the waits keep the seed's line breaks. Help's title is its Help label's, HELP (`help_title`).

kit.note: Extron's Shockwave resource kit. Each button is one image per state: `<color>_outline_nsel` at rest (dark, with a ring in its color) and `<color>_sel` when lit; a family with an icon is `<icon>_<color>`, and an r_ prefix makes it round. The source tabs' glyphs are `<icon>_white` on the bar's own color.

_source: Series, sizes, DPI and tier: GUI Designer's own TemplateInfoTable.config, through gdl/templates.py; each series' models are the MODELS_FULL models gdl.templates.template_for gives it, by model.

main and rail: off the series template's own Main* pages (tests/measure_series.py control_regions). On the tier A series main is the well - the shape inside the canvas the page's content sits on - and the rail the right band between the header and the footer capsule, which stands off the bottom edge.

The 520 and 535 hubs keep a menu bar down the right: main is the canvas left of it, its title strip included, since Extron places the standard popup over it; the rail is the bar. The 320 keeps nothing on screen from page to page - its volume is a popup no page opens - so it has no rail.
popup: the template's standard popup region, where it fills a quarter of the canvas or more.

backgrounds: haze is the template's own art where the kit has it pixel for pixel - the 520's and the 535's 800x480 bkgd.png, which the 535 stretches as its template does - keeping the template's name, which its seed carries with those pixels; else the kit's '<size> bkgd.png' at the series' size, else the nearest shape - the 5464x3072 on the 1720, the 1280x800 on the 320, whose own 320x240 the kit lacks - under the kit file's name, which the applier appends. Saturn is its one 5464x3072 file (tests/measure_series.py theme_backgrounds, own_art). The tier A templates draw SW_bkgd_01.png, which is no kit file's pixels.

seeds, kinds: each seed in seeds/ by part number and canvas, and what control kinds it can clone - the 720's, 725's, 1035's, 1525's and 1535's a slider and no level; the 320's, 525's and 535's a level and no slider; the 320's no popup, and no date and time to clone.; radii: the corner a series' own seed rounds a profile border at where that is not the profile's - the 520's, 535's and 320's 2D Rounded Rectangle at 10 px, the 1035's and 725's at 2 (tests/measure_series.py seed_radii)

frame: the series' working page in its template's own grammar, off its own seed (tests/measure_series.py frame_of; --frame prints each); its keys are docs/claude-design.md section 2's *Frame*. Shockwave's working page is Main SD on the bar series, the hubs' Main Page and the 320's Doc Cam 1.

frame.note: The tabs stand 1 px apart, so the photo draws a hairline between them. Each tab's name is a 152x36 caption under it, a button with the tab's ID and no fill or art; the tab draws no caption of its own. Power Down stands at the right rail's foot, beside the footer. The footer is a capsule standing off the bottom edge. The rails run down beside the footer, to the foot of the screen.
